_meta.purpose: Curated pairings for ingredients RecipeNLG doesn't carry (or carries under spellings that don't normalize). These hand-bootstrapped edges are merged into cuisine_pairings.json by scripts/17-merge-manual-pairings.js so they flow through getNeighborsEnriched alongside the corpus-derived pairs.
_meta.fabricatedCounts: Each entry gets count=25 + recipePct=0.10 = the smallest evidence shape that passes the displayableCuisine dominance gate without overclaiming. cuisineBoost() resolves these to strength ≈ 0.54.
_meta.provenanceFlag: Each synthesized pair record carries source='manual-bootstrap' so future audits can distinguish hand-edges from corpus-derived ones.
_meta.expansion_2026_05_17_pm: Partner lists expanded for the 4 sparse-pair targets (doenjang/huitlacoche/recaito/crema mexicana) to lift their cuisine-pair counts toward 30-40 edges each. Only canonical names confirmed present in ingredients.json were used.

epazote_extra.comment: epazote already has 51 corpus pairs but lacks the queso-trio + huitlacoche signal that defines Mexican cooking with it.
